1b3f3a66f6.why: The four instructions separately compute required vector, pointer, scalar-shift, and subtraction results.

0158afe3e4.why: The two shifts, two pointer increments, and final subtraction all produce distinct required outputs.

e0cc1132aa.why: Each instruction produces a required result, and no allowed instruction combines these independent scalar and vector operations.

9f56212c17.why: The arbitrary input byte requires all three modular subtractions and unsigned clamps, and the broadcast, ramp, final mask, and shuffled vectors are all live.

dfc60e8382.why: The arbitrary shuffle masks and coefficients require the separate arithmetic stages, while the live intermediates and saturation before the final word shift prevent folding them.
